description: Foundation: LMS types, Firestore service, shared components (CourseCard, ProgressBar, CourseOutline), and npm install flutterwave-react-v3. All downstream FEATs depend on this — FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 must not start until this is complete and the build is green.
steps: Install flutterwave-react-v3: run `npm install flutterwave-react-v3` in the worktree root (/Users/newmacbookair12/Documents/andrewstevenboima.github.io/Student_companion). This adds the package to package.json and package-lock.json.

Create src/types/lms.ts. Define and export the following interfaces (strict TypeScript, no `any`): Course { id, title, subtitle, description, thumbnailUrl, category, level, price: number, currency: 'RWF'|'USD', duration, lessonsCount: number, instructor, tags: string[], isPublished: boolean, isFeatured: boolean, trialModuleId?: string, scormUrl: string, createdAt?: unknown, updatedAt?: unknown }; Enrollment { userId, courseId, status: 'trial'|'enrolled'|'completed', paymentRef?: string, enrolledAt?: unknown, completedAt?: unknown }; CourseProgress { userId, courseId, percentComplete: number, lastAccessedAt?: unknown, scormData?: Record<string, unknown> }; CourseFilter { category?: string, level?: string, free?: boolean, search?: string }.

Create src/services/lmsService.ts. Import db from @/lib/firebase (Firestore) and types from @/types/lms. Use firebase/firestore: collection, doc, getDoc, getDocs, setDoc, query, where, orderBy, serverTimestamp, Timestamp. Implement and export: getCourses(filter?: CourseFilter): Promise<Course[]> — queries courses collection where isPublished==true, applies optional category/level/free filters; getCourse(id: string): Promise<Course | null>; getUserEnrollments(uid: string): Promise<Enrollment[]> — queries enrollments where userId==uid; enrollUserFree(uid: string, courseId: string): Promise<void> — writes doc `${uid}_${courseId}` to enrollments with status 'enrolled'; enrollUserPaid(uid: string, courseId: string, paymentRef: string): Promise<void> — same with paymentRef; updateProgress(uid: string, courseId: string, percent: number, scormData?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> — upserts progress doc `${uid}_${courseId}`; getProgress(uid: string, courseId: string): Promise<CourseProgress | null>; seedFirstCourse(): Promise<void> — uses setDoc with merge:true to write the Career Readiness 101 course doc (id: 'career-readiness-101') with all seed fields from the task spec.

Create src/components/lms/ProgressBar.tsx. Named export `ProgressBar`. Props: { percent: number, className?: string }. Renders shadcn Progress (`@/components/ui/progress`) with gold indicator. Override indicator color with a wrapper className trick: use `[&>div]:bg-[#D4AF37]` on the Progress root so the Radix indicator turns gold. Shows percent label to the right (e.g. '72%'). No inline styles.

Create src/components/lms/CourseCard.tsx. Named export `CourseCard`. Props: { course: Course, enrollment?: Enrollment, progress?: CourseProgress, onClick?: () => void }. Renders a shadcn Card with: thumbnail img (src=course.thumbnailUrl, fallback bg-alu-gold-soft), category Badge (variant='outline', gold border), title, subtitle (truncate), instructor, level badge, price display (0 → 'Free', else `${course.currency} ${course.price.toLocaleString()}`), ProgressBar if enrollment exists (percent=progress?.percentComplete ?? 0), and a CTA label ('Continue' if enrolled, 'Try Free' if trial, 'Enroll' if not enrolled). Card has hover:shadow-md transition. Uses only Tailwind classes and alu-* tokens.

Create src/components/lms/CourseOutline.tsx. Named export `CourseOutline`. Props: { course: Course, enrollment?: Enrollment, currentModule?: string, onModuleClick?: (moduleId: string) => void }. Renders a shadcn Accordion (from @/components/ui/accordion) listing mock modules derived from the course (generate N=course.lessonsCount module entries with titles like 'Module 1: Introduction', numbered 1..N). Each AccordionItem shows module title and a short description placeholder. Active module highlighted with bg-alu-gold-soft and text-alu-gold-strong. Locked modules (not enrolled/trial) show a Lock icon from lucide-react. Trial users can only access module-1 (trialModuleId). This component is stateless — caller manages which module is active.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 after FEAT-001 is complete
src/types/lms.ts exports Course, Enrollment, CourseProgress, CourseFilter with no `any`
src/services/lmsService.ts exports getCourses, getCourse, getUserEnrollments, enrollUserFree, enrollUserPaid, updateProgress, getProgress, seedFirstCourse — all return typed Promises
src/components/lms/ProgressBar.tsx, CourseCard.tsx, CourseOutline.tsx exist and compile without errors
findings: flutterwave-react-v3 was already present in package.json (v1.3.3) and node_modules — no install needed. Progress component (src/components/ui/progress.tsx) uses a ProgressPrimitive.Indicator with inline style for translateX. The [&>div]:bg-[#D4AF37] Tailwind override on the Progress root successfully colors it gold in the build. QueryConstraint from firebase/firestore is the correct type for Firestore query constraints — no `any` required. FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 can import from @/types/lms, @/services/lmsService, and @/components/lms/* without blockers.
